column1: # Produced by the monolith's own encoder (myassn.util.Argon2id.encode at the stated cost, behind the
# "\n2" one-way stored form DBPasswordDescriptor.encryptOneWayPassword writes) and checked against its
# verifier before being written here. Every verifier of a global user's stored credential runs these:
# the monolith's DBPasswordDescriptor.verifyPassword and web-global's authentication service.
# Columns, tab-separated: name, candidate, stored form, whether the candidate verifies.
# The stored form's leading newline is written as the two characters \n. Lines starting with # and
# blank lines are ignored. Never edit a row: a verifier that disagrees with one is the bug. Add rows.
# Cost ceilings these pin (the monolith's Argon2id.MAX_VERIFY_*): m <= 36864 KiB, t <= 16, p <= 4.
# A value above any of them is refused even for the right password ("*-refused" rows).
